style.name: Corporate Modernism
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: Corporate Modernism for global-news posters, using disciplined grids, modern sans-serif typography, modular cards, precise charts, rational whitespace, deep navy, graphite, warm white and restrained signal colors while keeping facts and information graphics dominant. Xiazi and Doudou stay small at the edges.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 关税、可控AI、单人经营、冰川洪灾、关键航道、公共卫生、极端温度与异常降雪构成今日风险地图
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营者要同时校准到岸成本、自动化边界、基础设施暴露和证据标准
zh-CN.headlineFull: 关税、可控AI、单人经营、冰川洪灾、关键航道、公共卫生、极端温度与异常降雪构成今日风险地图；经营者要同时校准到岸成本、自动化边界、基础设施暴露和证据标准
zh-CN.intro: 加拿大对美反制关税、Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash的可控视频能力和美国小企业BOI豁免改变经营工具箱；尼泊尔—西藏洪灾、霍尔木兹航运、刚果埃博拉、英国温度死亡数据与阿塔卡马异常降雪补齐安全、健康与气候信号。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的总览不是堆新闻，而是看成本、工具与风险如何互相传导。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先圈出会改变价格、权限或交付的三件事。

en-US.headlineFact: Tariffs, controllable AI, solo operations, a glacial flood, a vital shipping lane, public health, temperature mortality and desert snow form today's risk map
en-US.headlineView: operators need to recalibrate landed cost, automation boundaries, infrastructure exposure and evidence standards
en-US.headlineFull: Tariffs, controllable AI, solo operations, a glacial flood, a vital shipping lane, public health, temperature mortality and desert snow form today's risk map; operators need to recalibrate landed cost, automation boundaries, infrastructure exposure and evidence standards
en-US.intro: Canadian counter-tariffs, Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash video controls and a US BOI exemption reshape the operator toolkit; the Nepal-Tibet flood, Hormuz shipping risk, Congo Ebola, UK temperature-mortality data and rare Atacama snow complete the safety, health and climate map.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A real overview shows how cost, tools and risk travel together instead of stacking headlines.
en-US.doudouQuote: Circle the three signals that change price, permission or delivery today.

sources.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash lets you build with more control

zh-CN.headlineFact: 加拿大将从9月8日起对价值276亿加元的美国商品征收15%、25%或50%反制关税
zh-CN.headlineView: 跨境卖家应按税则号和原产地重算到岸成本，不要统一涨价
zh-CN.headlineFull: 加拿大将从9月8日起对价值276亿加元的美国商品征收15%、25%或50%反制关税；跨境卖家应按税则号和原产地重算到岸成本，不要统一涨价
zh-CN.intro: 加拿大财政部表示，反制税将逐项匹配美国税率，覆盖钢铁、乳制品、家电、农机、纸浆纸张和电子产品，并配套75亿加元支持；卖家现在应复核SKU编码、库存原产地、DDP报价和退货成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 关税不是平均数，它会沿着每个SKU走出不同路径。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先导出受影响税则号，再改价格和补货。

en-US.headlineFact: Canada will impose 15, 25 or 50 percent counter-tariffs on C$27.6 billion of US goods from September 8
en-US.headlineView: cross-border sellers should recalculate landed cost by tariff code and origin instead of raising every price
en-US.headlineFull: Canada will impose 15, 25 or 50 percent counter-tariffs on C$27.6 billion of US goods from September 8; cross-border sellers should recalculate landed cost by tariff code and origin instead of raising every price
en-US.intro: Canada's finance ministry says the measures will match US rates item by item across steel, dairy, appliances, farm equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics, alongside C$7.5 billion in support; operators should review SKU codes, inventory origin, DDP quotes and return costs now.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A tariff is not an average; it travels through each SKU differently.
en-US.doudouQuote: Export the affected tariff codes before changing prices and replenishment.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Google发布Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，把生成视频延长、首尾帧插值与4K放大带入API
zh-CN.headlineView: 生成式视频竞争正从能生成转向能控制、能迭代、能投入生产
zh-CN.headlineFull: Google发布Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash，把生成视频延长、首尾帧插值与4K放大带入API；生成式视频竞争正从能生成转向能控制、能迭代、能投入生产
zh-CN.intro: Omni 1.1可读取最多10秒前文并把场景累计延长到40秒，支持指定首尾关键帧、360p低成本预览和4K放大；对开发者而言，工作流控制与一致性比单次炫技更接近真实生产价值。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 创意模型进入生产，关键不是惊喜，而是可控、可复现和可交付。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先用360p试镜，再把值得保留的镜头升到4K。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: Google released Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with scene extension, first-last-frame interpolation and 4K upscaling through its API
en-US.headlineView: generative video competition is shifting from producing output to controlling, iterating and deploying it
en-US.headlineFull: Google released Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with scene extension, first-last-frame interpolation and 4K upscaling through its API; generative video competition is shifting from producing output to controlling, iterating and deploying it
en-US.intro: Omni 1.1 can use up to 10 seconds of prior context and extend scenes to a cumulative 40 seconds, while supporting start and end keyframes, low-cost 360p previews and 4K upscaling; workflow control and consistency move the model closer to production value.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When creative models enter production, control, repeatability and delivery matter more than surprise.
en-US.doudouQuote: Audition in 360p, then upscale only the shots worth keeping.

sources.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash lets you build with more control

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国最终规则让超过3200万小企业主免于提交受益所有权信息，并要求删除已收集数据
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司获得合规减负，但永久确定性仍取决于国会立法
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国最终规则让超过3200万小企业主免于提交受益所有权信息，并要求删除已收集数据；一人公司获得合规减负，但永久确定性仍取决于国会立法
zh-CN.intro: NFIB称，美国财政部最终规则免除美国小企业的BOI申报并承诺删除已收集信息；协会同时推动国会彻底废除相关条款，避免未来政府恢复要求。单人经营者应区分当前规则与长期法律保障。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 合规减负能立刻释放时间，但长期确定性来自更稳定的制度。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把现在免报和永久废除分成两列跟踪。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: A US final rule exempts more than 32 million small-business owners from beneficial-ownership reporting and requires deletion of collected data
en-US.headlineView: solo operators gain compliance relief, but permanent certainty still depends on legislation
en-US.headlineFull: A US final rule exempts more than 32 million small-business owners from beneficial-ownership reporting and requires deletion of collected data; solo operators gain compliance relief, but permanent certainty still depends on legislation
en-US.intro: NFIB says the Treasury final rule exempts American small businesses from BOI filings and commits to deleting collected information; the group is also pushing Congress to repeal the provision so a future administration cannot restore it. Operators should separate the current rule from durable legal protection.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Compliance relief returns time immediately, but long-term certainty comes from a more durable rulebook.
en-US.doudouQuote: Track exempt now and repealed permanently in two separate columns.

sources.title: US beneficial ownership final rule for small businesses

zh-CN.headlineFact: 尼泊尔—西藏冰岩崩塌洪灾造成重大伤亡，1300多人失联，桥梁与道路大面积中断
zh-CN.headlineView: 高山灾害会把搜救、旅游、水电与跨境交通同时拖入失联状态
zh-CN.headlineFull: 尼泊尔—西藏冰岩崩塌洪灾造成重大伤亡，1300多人失联，桥梁与道路大面积中断；高山灾害会把搜救、旅游、水电与跨境交通同时拖入失联状态
zh-CN.intro: 多方报道显示，冰岩崩塌引发巨量泥水沿河谷下泄，至少19座桥和约40公里道路受损，救援仍在快速更新；准确伤亡数字尚未稳定，当前优先级是搜救、撤离、通信和下游二次洪灾预警。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 高山基础设施是一条共同承载生命、救援与贸易的脆弱链。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 数字会更新，先把人、路、桥和通信接回来。

en-US.headlineFact: The Nepal-Tibet ice-rock collapse flood caused mass casualties, left more than 1,300 missing and severed bridges and roads
en-US.headlineView: a high-mountain disaster can disconnect rescue, tourism, hydropower and cross-border transport at once
en-US.headlineFull: The Nepal-Tibet ice-rock collapse flood caused mass casualties, left more than 1,300 missing and severed bridges and roads; a high-mountain disaster can disconnect rescue, tourism, hydropower and cross-border transport at once
en-US.intro: Reports indicate that an ice-rock avalanche drove a huge debris flood down the valley, damaging at least 19 bridges and about 40 kilometers of road; casualty figures remain fluid, while search, evacuation, communications and downstream warning are the immediate priorities.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Mountain infrastructure is a fragile chain shared by lives, rescue and trade.
en-US.doudouQuote: The numbers will change; reconnect people, roads, bridges and communications first.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 霍尔木兹海峡再报油轮遇袭，卡塔尔推动降级，伊朗与阿曼讨论临时航道和排雷
zh-CN.headlineView: 外交出现出口不等于航运风险已经解除，保险与通航验证仍是硬门
zh-CN.headlineFull: 霍尔木兹海峡再报油轮遇袭，卡塔尔推动降级，伊朗与阿曼讨论临时航道和排雷；外交出现出口不等于航运风险已经解除，保险与通航验证仍是硬门
zh-CN.intro: 卡塔尔外长赴德黑兰推动缓和，同时一艘油轮再遭袭击；伊朗与阿曼提出商业船舶临时通道、交通管理和清雷框架。承运商应按实际船舶通行、保险条款和港口时效调整承诺。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一条航道真正开放，要由安全通过的船只而不是标题证明。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先看第一艘船怎么走，再改运价表。

en-US.headlineFact: Another tanker attack was reported in Hormuz as Qatar pushed de-escalation and Iran and Oman discussed a temporary corridor and mine clearance
en-US.headlineView: a diplomatic exit does not remove shipping risk until passage and insurance are verified
en-US.headlineFull: Another tanker attack was reported in Hormuz as Qatar pushed de-escalation and Iran and Oman discussed a temporary corridor and mine clearance; a diplomatic exit does not remove shipping risk until passage and insurance are verified
en-US.intro: Qatar's foreign minister visited Tehran to support de-escalation while another tanker attack was reported; Iran and Oman proposed a temporary commercial corridor, traffic management and mine clearance. Carriers should tie commitments to actual vessel movement, policy wording and port timing.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A corridor is open when ships prove they can pass safely, not when a headline says so.
en-US.doudouQuote: Watch how the first ship moves before changing the freight sheet.

sources.title: Regional powers seek off-ramp from Iran war as another tanker attack is reported

zh-CN.headlineFact: 刚果埃博拉确诊5713例、死亡2744例，重灾区家长与教师要求延后9月1日开学
zh-CN.headlineView: 公共服务恢复必须与传播速度、儿童风险和防护能力一起判断
zh-CN.headlineFull: 刚果埃博拉确诊5713例、死亡2744例，重灾区家长与教师要求延后9月1日开学；公共服务恢复必须与传播速度、儿童风险和防护能力一起判断
zh-CN.intro: 刚果卫生部门数据表明疫情仍快速增长，四岁及以下儿童病死率尤其高；学校恢复既关系教育，也可能放大接触网络。决策需要把病例趋势、接触追踪、隔离能力和学校防护放在同一张表上。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 恢复日常不能只看日历，还要看传播链是否真的被压住。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 开学铃响之前，先确认防护、追踪和隔离都在线。

en-US.headlineFact: Congo reported 5,713 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,744 deaths as parents and teachers urged delaying the September 1 school reopening
en-US.headlineView: restoring public services must be judged alongside transmission speed, child risk and protection capacity
en-US.headlineFull: Congo reported 5,713 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,744 deaths as parents and teachers urged delaying the September 1 school reopening; restoring public services must be judged alongside transmission speed, child risk and protection capacity
en-US.intro: Congolese health data indicate that the outbreak is still growing rapidly and that children aged four and under face especially high fatality; reopening schools affects education but can also expand contact networks. Case trends, tracing, isolation and school safeguards belong on one decision sheet.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Returning to normal depends on whether transmission is being suppressed, not only on the calendar.
en-US.doudouQuote: Before the school bell rings, check protection, tracing and isolation.

sources.title: Parents and teachers in Congo urge delay of school resumption as Ebola outbreak rages on

zh-CN.headlineFact: 英国统计局估算1988—2025年英格兰约40063例死亡与最热日相关，威尔士约2070例
zh-CN.headlineView: 寒冷相关死亡仍更多，但热冷差距正在缩小，老年人与伦敦暴露更高
zh-CN.headlineFull: 英国统计局估算1988—2025年英格兰约40063例死亡与最热日相关，威尔士约2070例；寒冷相关死亡仍更多，但热冷差距正在缩小，老年人与伦敦暴露更高
zh-CN.intro: ONS用38年温度与死亡数据建模，发现最热2.5%与最冷2.5%的日子都提高风险；65岁以上人群更脆弱。该结果是模型估计而非逐例归因，提醒城市把热浪、住房和健康响应纳入长期规划。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 气候风险需要把天气曲线和真实健康结果放在同一张图上。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 别只看最高温，还要看谁最难获得降温和照护。

en-US.headlineFact: ONS estimates linked about 40,063 deaths in England and 2,070 in Wales to the hottest days from 1988 to 2025
en-US.headlineView: cold-related deaths remain higher, but the heat-cold gap is narrowing and older people and London face greater exposure
en-US.headlineFull: ONS estimates linked about 40,063 deaths in England and 2,070 in Wales to the hottest days from 1988 to 2025; cold-related deaths remain higher, but the heat-cold gap is narrowing and older people and London face greater exposure
en-US.intro: ONS modeled 38 years of temperature and mortality data and found higher risk on the hottest and coldest 2.5 percent of days, with people aged 65 and over more vulnerable. These are modeled estimates rather than individual attributions, pointing cities toward long-term heat, housing and health planning.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Climate risk becomes actionable when weather curves and health outcomes share the same chart.
en-US.doudouQuote: Do not only track the maximum; track who cannot reach cooling and care.

sources.title: Climate-related mortality, England and Wales: 1988 to 2025

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA卫星记录阿塔卡马沙漠异常大范围降雪，从安第斯山延伸至接近太平洋海岸
zh-CN.headlineView: 极端干旱区的罕见降水会同时影响天文台、道路、住宅与洪灾风险
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA卫星记录阿塔卡马沙漠异常大范围降雪，从安第斯山延伸至接近太平洋海岸；极端干旱区的罕见降水会同时影响天文台、道路、住宅与洪灾风险
zh-CN.intro: Landsat与Terra影像显示两轮冬季风暴覆盖智利北部；塔尔塔尔三天降雨接近40毫米，约为年均十倍，部分天文台暂停运行，泥石流和洪水影响数千人。异常天气需要影像、地面雨量和灾情联合判断。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 卫星看到的是白色覆盖，地面承受的是交通、住房与设备风险。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 沙漠下雪很美，排水和道路却先接受压力测试。

en-US.headlineFact: NASA satellites recorded rare widespread snow across the Atacama Desert from the Andes to near the Pacific coast
en-US.headlineView: unusual precipitation in an extreme desert can affect observatories, roads, homes and flood risk at the same time
en-US.headlineFull: NASA satellites recorded rare widespread snow across the Atacama Desert from the Andes to near the Pacific coast; unusual precipitation in an extreme desert can affect observatories, roads, homes and flood risk at the same time
en-US.intro: Landsat and Terra imagery showed two winter storms covering northern Chile; Taltal received nearly 40 millimeters of rain in three days, about ten times its annual mean, as observatories paused and mudflows and floods affected thousands. Imagery, gauges and damage reports need to be read together.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Satellites see white cover while people on the ground carry transport, housing and equipment risk.
en-US.doudouQuote: Desert snow is beautiful, but drainage and roads take the stress test first.

sources.title: Rare widespread snow in the Atacama Desert
